title: Concrete poured on floors 2 and 3
body: Concrete has been poured for floors 2 and 3. The main-floor pour is expected to be finished by the end of this week.
imageAlt: Front view of RECPLACE Professional Centre with concrete trucks and a concrete pump on site

images.imageAlt: October 13 aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre with its painted exterior, glazing, and roof
October 13 aerial view of the roof at RECPLACE Professional Centre

title: Window installation underway
body: Window frames are being installed across the building, including the tall corner openings.
imageAlt: September 23 detail of new window framing across RECPLACE's painted facade, with work continuing at the larger openings

title: Exterior painting underway
body: Exterior painting is underway in white, charcoal, and orange.
imageAlt: September 17 aerial view of RECPLACE's white, charcoal, and orange exterior, with the window openings still largely unglazed

title: Structure complete
body: The building structure and precast panel installation are complete. The crane has left the site.

images.imageAlt: Front aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre with the building structure and precast panels in place
Angled aerial view of the RECPLACE structure and roof beside Highway 16
Wide aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre and its construction site beside Highway 16
Aerial view of the RECPLACE construction site within Prince George's commercial corridor
Closer aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre's concrete three-storey structure and roof framing

title: Third floor is in
body: The third floor is now in place.
imageAlt: Wide aerial view of RECPLACE Professional Centre after the third floor was installed

title: Third floor underway
body: Construction is underway on the third floor.
imageAlt: Aerial view of RECPLACE with third-floor construction underway

title: Precast installation begins
body: Precast wall panels have arrived on site, and installation has begun.
imageAlt: Crane, precast wall panels, and installation activity at the RECPLACE site

title: Foundation work underway
body: Work on the footings and foundations continued through June.
imageAlt: Aerial detail of RECPLACE footings and foundation work

title: Groundbreaking
body: Construction has officially begun at RECPLACE Professional Centre, 2740 Recplace Drive.
imageAlt: Project attendees taking part in the RECPLACE groundbreaking ceremony
